description: List side pages attached to a landing page. Default detail='short'. Heavy JSONB (overrides/config) only at full via view_side_page. Every detail level includes previewUrl (a browser-openable draft-preview link, always available) and liveUrl (a browser-openable public link, present only when a custom domain is connected). medium/full also include currentVersionId (the draft) and publishedVersionId (the live version) per row — compare them to spot pages with unpublished draft edits without a second call.

detail.description: Verbosity of returned item(s): "short" = id + primary label + status (cheap list scan); "medium" = key summary fields + counts (a useful glance); "full" = the complete object. Default "short". Lists default to "short" — to zoom into one item, call its get/view tool with detail="medium" or "full".

name: list_side_pages
